test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Complete the sentence with an appropriate synonym of the word mentioned in the bracket. **

Watching the setting sun and the _______ (tranquil) surface of the water relaxes my mind.
solution: The correct answer is '**calm**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**tranquil**' is '**calm**'. • **Tranquil**: quiet and peaceful. (शांत, प्रशांत) • *Example: **tranquil** scene/waters/ life...* • **Calm**: not excited, worried or angry; quiet. (शांत, चुपचाप) • *Example: Try to keep **calm**—there’s no need to panic.*** Correct Sentence:__** *Watching the setting sun and the calm surface of the water relaxes my mind.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Unsettled**: (used about a situation) that may change; making people uncertain about what might happen. [(स्थिति) जिसमें परिवर्तन संभावित है, अस्थिर; भावी के विषय में अनिश्‍चित] • **Moving**: causing strong feelings, especially of sadness. [भावावेश (विशेषतः विषाद) को जन्‍म देने वाली; हृदयस्‍पर्शी, प्रभावशाली] • **Roaring**: making a very loud noise. [ज़ोर से शोर करते हुए, गरजते या दहाड़ते हुए] 34:Tb3b, The incorrectly spelt word is '**Whipe**'.
